owner_request: 2026-10-08 接进菜单，然后继续做出场方式 (Notion #14 sub-task: 出场方式 - 固定持有 vs 跟踪止损 vs 分批)
question: On the same sync-shock events, does any exit rule - trailing stop, break-even stop or scaling out - beat a fixed 12h hold, after cost and against matched random entries with the same exit, in both periods?
single_variable: Exit rule only: events (v2 loosest config, single sync bar, 24h cooldown, 30m and 1H), next-open entry, 0.2% round trip, universe, controls and the 2025 split are unchanged; every rule is applied to the same events and to their matched controls.
data: frozen Binance USD-M 5m series as in v2 (warmup 2022-11-01, events 2023-01-01 to 2026-09-23)
atr: Wilder ATR(14) of the instrument on the event timeframe at the signal bar (v2 Panel2). Every exit, fixed holds included, runs on one price path per instrument: ETH and BTC bars, and for alts v2's rebalanced equal-weight index (v2's fixed-hold alt numbers were per-alt buy-and-hold, so v5's alt holds differ slightly from v2's)

exits.hold_12h: exit at the close 12h after entry (baseline)
exits.hold_24h: exit at the close 24h after entry
exits.trail3_24h: stop 2ATR from entry, trail 3ATR from the best close, close-based, 24h cap (v2 trend exit)
exits.trail2_24h: stop 2ATR from entry, trail 2ATR from the best close, close-based, 24h cap
exits.trail3_48h: stop 2ATR from entry, trail 3ATR from the best close, close-based, 48h cap
exits.be_24h: stop 2ATR from entry; after a close 1ATR in profit the stop moves to entry; close-based, 24h cap
exits.tp2_trail3_24h: half exits at the first close 2ATR in profit, the rest trails 3ATR (stop 2ATR), 24h cap; without the target the whole position trails
exits.split_4h_24h: half exits at the 4h close, half at the 24h close

primary.read: per exit, mean paired difference against hold_12h on the same events in each period; better = positive in both periods with month-block sign-flip p < 0.05 in at least one

selection: per timeframe, side and instrument: the exit with the largest excess-over-control t before select_before (>= 30 events), read once after
path_rule: an event or control counts only when its 48h close path after entry is complete, so every exit is read on the identical event set
v2_reconciliation: events must equal v2 events.csv for the config; trail3_24h must equal v2 'trend' gross and hold_12h/hold_24h must equal v2 time_12h/time_24h gross for eth and btc on shared events
